verdict.rationale: Hatchet's core model is event-driven, declarative workflows: docs show event filters (CEL expressions), cron triggers, and concurrency rules where multiple workflows/tasks consume the same event/key, and the founder confirms workflow execution paths are declared ahead of time. This supports events triggering workflows and fanning out to multiple tasks, though evidence never explicitly names webhooks or queue-based triggers as a first-class integration nor shows a concrete one-event-to-many-functions example. Missing for 10: explicit webhook/queue trigger documentation, a concrete fan-out-to-many-functions example or diagram.
